REVISION OF LAWS ACT 1968
REVISION OF LAWS (PUBLIC TRUSTEE Acr 1950) ORDER 1982

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 15 of the Revision
of Laws Act 1968, the Commissioner of Law Revision, with the
approval of the Law Revision Committee, makes the following
Order:

1. This Order may be cited as the Revision of Laws (Public
Trustee Act 1950) Order 1982 and shall be deemed to have come
into force on 14th May 1981.                   '

2. The Public Trustee Act 1950 (Act 247) is rectified as follows:

(i) by substituting "Application by person aggrieved to
Court" for "Appeal to Court from Public Trustee"
appearing in the marginal note to section 20;

(ii) by substituting "shall be liable to imprisonment for a
term not exceeding two years" for "shall be liable to
imprisonment of either description for a term not exeed-
ing two years" appearing in section 22 (10).

Made the 26th April 1982.
[P.N. (S.U. 2) 207; PN. (PU?) 231.]

TAN Sri DATUK CHANG MIN TAT,
Commissioner of Law Revision,
Malaysia
